title: Tako CLI Configuration
description: Configuration schema for Tako CLI (tako.yaml or tako.json)

^x-.description: Extension key: accepted and ignored. Use it to hold shared fragments and YAML anchors.

secretSources.description: External secret stores read live whenever Tako resolves secrets (deploy, exec, validate). Sources hold provider selectors only, never values. Later sources override earlier ones, and provider values override .tako/secrets files.

provider.description: Provider name or alias (see `tako secrets providers`)

names.description: Explicit provider secret names; omit to use the provider's listing mode

path.description: Provider path or name prefix to read recursively (Infisical: secret folder)

vault.description: 1Password vault or Azure Key Vault name

project.description: GCP project, Doppler project, Infisical project ID, or Bitwarden project ID

providerEnv.description: Doppler config or Infisical environment slug

prefixStrip.description: Prefix removed from provider names before deriving secret keys

map.description: Provider secret name to Tako secret key

aliases.description: Project command aliases: `tako <alias> [args...]` runs `tako <alias args...> [args...]`. Values are Tako arguments (list form, preferred) or one string split on whitespace with shell-style quoting but no shell. Values are literal: ${...} references are rejected. Built-in commands always take precedence over aliases.

oneOf.description: Tako arguments as one string, e.g. "logs web --follow"
Tako arguments, e.g. [exec, -it, web, --, bin/rails, console]

hooks.description: Local lifecycle hooks: executables in the hook directory or argv commands that run on the operator's machine (never on nodes) around deploy, rollback, promote, and setup. Hooks get a curated, secret-free environment; see docs/HOOKS.md.

path.description: Hook directory relative to the directory containing the config file. Must stay inside the project and outside the gitignored .tako/ directory.

timeout.description: Per-hook timeout as a Go duration from 1s to 1h. On timeout the hook's whole process tree is terminated.

output.description: verbose emits hook output lines at info level; quiet emits them at debug level (shown with --verbose and always present in NDJSON).

passEnv.description: Process variables forwarded to hooks: exact names or a single trailing * prefix pattern. Nothing else from the process environment, including .env values, reaches a hook. TAKO_ names are reserved.

commands.description: Hooks declared as argv lists, run without a shell from the project directory. ${...} references are rejected; forward variables with passEnv. A hook defined here and as a file is an error.

$schema.description: JSON Schema reference for IDE support

name.description: App namespace. Keep this stable and unique per product on shared nodes.

version.description: Project metadata version. Build-backed deploy artifacts are tagged by Git commit; this does not need to change to redeploy.

builds.description: Reusable image builds referenced by services through imageFrom.

runtime.description: takod mesh runtime settings. One node and many nodes use the same runtime model.

enabled.description: Must be true; takod agent is required
Must be true; single-node deploys use a one-node mesh

registries.description: Private image registry credentials keyed by host (e.g. ghcr.io). Passwords must be ${ENV_VAR} references; credentials are request-scoped and never persisted on nodes.

password.description: Registry password or token. Must be an ${ENV_VAR} reference.

privateHost.description: Private/LAN/VPN address used by `tako domains hosts` for internal proxy routes

transport.description: Transport for routine takod operations. Omitted preserves legacy SSH behavior; auto/local require immutable clusterId and nodeId.

clusterId.description: Immutable enrolled cluster identity used to authenticate local transport.

nodeId.description: Immutable enrolled node identity used to authenticate local transport.

workerUid.description: Persisted UID of the protected local platform worker, used for Unix peer authentication.

strategy.description: Deprecated and has no effect; rejected starting in v0.15.0. Services deploy sequentially in dependency order: use services.<name>.dependsOn for ordering and services.<name>.deploy.strategy for rollout, then remove this key.

parallel.description: Deprecated and has no effect; rejected starting in v0.15.0. Services deploy sequentially in dependency order: use services.<name>.dependsOn for ordering and services.<name>.deploy.strategy for rollout, then remove this key.

cache.description: Deprecated and has no effect; rejected starting in v0.15.0. Build cache is managed by Docker: use `tako cleanup --docker-cache` or the takod --build-cache-keep-storage setting, then remove this key.

build.description: Where build-backed service images are produced before takod reconciles containers. remote keeps the current server-side build path. local builds with Docker buildx on the developer or CI machine and pushes to each assigned node through docker-pussh/unregistry. auto tries local first and falls back to remote.

alerts.description: Durable scheduled-job and backup alert policy

noSuccessFor.description: Alert when a scheduled job has no successful run for this Go duration (1m to 8760h)

maxAge.description: Alert when the latest successful scheduled backup exceeds this Go duration (1m to 8760h)

owner.description: Creation-only numeric uid or uid:gid for a fresh Tako-managed local volume

extends.description: Inherit from another environment: this environment's keys are deep-merged over the resolved parent. Mappings merge by key, scalars and lists replace, and null removes an inherited key. At most 8 extends hops.

abstract.description: Template-only environment: usable as an extends target but never validated, deployed, or chosen as the default. Not inherited.

preview.description: Makes this environment a preview base for `tako deploy --preview <name>`. Not inherited. See docs/PREVIEW-ENVIRONMENTS.md.

domain.description: Host template of every proxied preview service. Placeholders: {name}, {service}, {domain}. Default {name}.{domain}.

ttl.description: Preview lifetime after each successful deploy, as a duration such as 72h, or none. Default 168h.

max.description: Maximum number of previews of this base. Default 5.

maxReplicas.description: Replica cap of every non-global preview service. Default 1.

keepJobs.description: Keep kind: job services in previews. Default false.

env.description: Environment variables merged into every preview service. Placeholders: {name}, {host:<service>}, {url:<service>}.
Environment variables merged into this preview service, with the same placeholders as preview.env.

serverSelector.description: Label-based server selection, used instead of an explicit servers list. Selects every server whose servers.<name>.labels match all labels, or every server when any is true.

labels.description: Match servers that carry all of these labels
Deprecated and has no effect; rejected starting in v0.15.0. Set servers.<name>.labels and select them with serverSelector.labels or placement constraints.

proxy.description: Environment-level proxy placement. Built-in public ACME TLS requires placement to resolve to one proxy node until distributed certificate handling is implemented.

placement.description: Where proxy routes should be reconciled

preferences.description: Reserved; placement preferences are not supported yet and validation rejects any entry.

acme.description: Environment-scoped DNS-01 provider used by wildcard routes and routes with proxy.tls.challenge=dns. Credentials must be whole ${ENV_VAR} references and are persisted only on proxy nodes.

credentials.description: Provider credential values. apiToken is required; cloudflare also accepts optional zoneToken.

build.description: Build context path or structured build options

dockerfile.description: Dockerfile path relative to the build context

imageFrom.description: Reference a top-level shared build. For kind: run, this may instead reference another service, which becomes an implicit dependency.

ports.description: Raw TCP/UDP host ports published directly on the node, bypassing tako-proxy ("PORT", "HOST:CONTAINER", "IP:HOST:CONTAINER", optional /tcp or /udp). Requires deploy.strategy recreate and at most one replica; when deploy.strategy is omitted, a service with ports defaults to recreate.

command.description: Override container command. String form preserves Tako's legacy sh -c behavior; list form is passed as raw exec argv.

entrypoint.description: Override the image entrypoint as a string executable or argv list.

labels.description: Custom container labels. Keys beginning with tako. are reserved.

envFiles.description: Ordered .env files; later files override earlier files

stopGracePeriod.description: Whole-second container stop timeout, for example 60s

files.description: Local regular files or directories distributed through takod and mounted read-only into the container.

secret.description: Force private 0700/0600 modes for the distributed tree.

owner.description: Numeric uid or uid:gid that owns the published tree; defaults to a numeric service user or root.

backup.description: Optional takod-managed periodic backups for named service volumes, or storage-only configuration for verifying external database-native artifacts.

retain.description: Days to retain local and object-storage backups

volumes.description: Optional logical service volume names to back up. Omit to back up every named volume on the service.

storage.description: Optional S3-compatible object storage target for off-node backup copies

region.description: AWS region or auto for Cloudflare R2

endpoint.description: Required for r2 and s3-compatible providers

accessKeyId.description: Use an environment variable such as ${TAKO_BACKUP_ACCESS_KEY_ID}

secretAccessKey.description: Use an environment variable such as ${TAKO_BACKUP_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY}

forcePathStyle.description: Enable for MinIO and some S3-compatible stores

versioned.description: Use object-version listing and exact version deletion for retention

persistent.description: Mark as stateful/persistent. Requires at least one volume, and multi-node environments require pinned or global placement.

kind.description: Workload kind: service (default), job (cron schedule), or run (fingerprinted deploy-time run-to-completion step).

schedule.description: kind: job only. Cron expression (five fields or descriptors like @hourly), evaluated in UTC unless timezone is set.

timezone.description: kind: job only. IANA timezone the schedule is evaluated in (e.g. Asia/Manila).

timeout.description: kind: job or kind: run only. Duration such as 30m to kill an execution after (default 1h).

memory.description: Docker memory limit passed as --memory, for example 512m or 1g

cpus.description: Docker CPU limit passed as --cpus, for example 0.5 or 2

proxy.description: Proxy settings. Public routes use ACME-backed HTTPS; internal routes are HTTP-only private-network routes.

visibility.description: Use public for DNS/ACME ingress or internal for private-network HTTP ingress

domain.description: Primary public hostname. Wildcards require environment proxy.acme and use DNS-01.

host.description: Internal hostname for proxy.visibility=internal. Defaults to <service>.<environment>.<project>.tako.internal.

domains.description: Additional co-equal serving hostnames beside domain. Each serves the same upstreams with its own certificate; domain stays the primary for URLs and redirects.

redirectFrom.description: Hostnames to redirect from. Wildcard hostnames are not supported by the built-in proxy yet.

basicAuth.description: HTTP basic authentication enforced at the proxy for every route of this service.

passwordBcrypt.description: Pre-computed bcrypt hash of the password (never the plaintext). Mint one with `tako proxy hash-password`.

allowIps.description: Client IPs/CIDRs allowed to reach this service through the proxy; all others get 403. Matches the TCP peer unless trustedProxies is configured, then matches the parsed client IP.

trustedProxies.description: Proxy/CDN CIDRs, or the presets cloudfront and cloudflare, whose forwarded client IP headers may be trusted. Presets are resolved to the CDN's published ranges on the deploying machine (cached for 24 hours in the user cache directory) and require takod capability proxy.trusted-proxy-presets-v1. IPv4 prefixes broader than /8 and IPv6 prefixes broader than /24 are rejected. All routes sharing a proxy node must declare the same nonempty set (same CIDRs and same presets).

denyPathPrefixes.description: Absolute literal path prefixes denied with 404 before authentication, request-body reads, or proxying. Each entry matches the exact path and segment children; for example /api/internal matches /api/internal and /api/internal/* without matching /api/internalized.

allowPathPrefixes.description: When nonempty, only exact literal path prefixes and segment children are served; all other paths receive 404 before authentication, request-body reads, or proxying. denyPathPrefixes takes precedence.

maxRequestBody.description: Maximum request body accepted by this route, for example 10MB. Oversized requests receive 413.

responseHeaders.description: Response headers added or replaced for this route. Hop-by-hop and message-framing headers are rejected.

requestHeaders.description: Literal headers set on every request forwarded to this service (Caddy header_up), for example X-Forwarded-Host: www.example.com behind CloudFront. Overrides Caddy's default X-Forwarded-Host/X-Forwarded-Proto for this route only. Values are visible ASCII without placeholders ({ }), quotes, or backslashes. Hop-by-hop, framing, Host, X-Forwarded-For, Forwarded, and X-Real-IP are rejected. Requires takod capability proxy.request-headers-v1.

cdn.description: Explicitly declares that DNS terminates at an external CDN. Required for strict domain readiness when DNS probes detect a proxied edge.

mode.description: auto for public ACME-backed routes; off for internal HTTP-only routes

challenge.description: dns opts explicit hostnames into takod-managed DNS-01. Wildcard hostnames imply dns.

dynamicDomains.description: Optional Caddy on-demand TLS domain authority. ask uses <service>:<path> and is called before certificates are issued for generated/custom domains. The ask endpoint must approve only exact domains owned by this app/environment.

ask.description: Internal ask endpoint reference, for example admin:/api/domains/authorize

command.description: Docker health command (mutually exclusive with path and tcpPort).

deploy.description: Deployment strategy for takod reconciliation. When strategy is omitted, Tako selects rolling for a stateless long-running service that declares port and no raw ports or volumes, is not persistent, sets no maxUnavailable, a maxSurge of 0 or at least replicas, and no gracePeriod, promotion, or smokeTest, and would pass rolling validation; every other service (persistent, raw ports, volumes, portless workers) defaults to recreate. A defaulted rolling service without healthCheck or deploy.readiness waits for a TCP connect to port before traffic shifts. recreate stops the previous containers, keeps them restorable until the new revision passes health checks on every node, and restores them when the rollout fails (rollbackOnFailure). rolling warms a full replacement revision, waits for readiness, switches proxy routes, then prunes stale revisions. blue_green warms a full green revision for stateless public services, waits for readiness and optional smoke tests, and switches proxy routes only after checks pass. Default automatic promotion switches during deploy; promotion: manual warms green for a later tako promote <service>. deploy.gracePeriod can retain the previous blue-green revision after promotion before stale revision cleanup.

rollbackOnFailure.description: Defaults to true: a failed rollout leaves the previous revision serving. recreate keeps the stopped previous containers and restarts them on every node of the service when any node fails; rolling never cuts traffic over. false disables recreate restore and keeps failed new containers stopped but not removed for debugging. Needs takod capability deploy.restore-on-failure-v1 when set explicitly; when omitted, older nodes fall back to legacy remove-then-start with a warning.

gracePeriod.description: blue_green only. Duration such as 30s or 2m to keep the previous revision running after proxy promotion before stale revision cleanup.

release.description: Release command run from the new image exactly once per deploy, before traffic cutover; a non-zero exit aborts the rollout.

timeout.description: Duration such as 5m to kill the release command after (default 5m).

volumes.description: Mount the service's volumes into the release container (default false).

preferences.description: Reserved; placement preferences are not supported yet and validation rejects any entry.

healthCheck.description: Proxy-side upstream health checks. When enabled, path defaults to healthCheck.path or /health and interval defaults to 10s.

monitoring.description: Per-service monitoring used by tako monitor

export.description: Attach this service to a service-scoped export network for other projects

imports.description: Import services from other projects as project.service in the same environment
